CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION AGENDA
  TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 28, 2023
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Kathleen Irvine, Chair  Mark Grisafe, Commissioner
Kevin McGuan, Vice Chair  Tasha Hunter, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner

  CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO PROVIDE PUBLIC COMMENT IN THE
  ZOOM MEETING BY USING THE RAISE HAND FUNCTION, OR PRESSING *9 ON YOUR
  PHONE

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 954 4193 2207
  https://longbeach-
  gov.zoom.us/j/95441932207?pwd=WTFINzErRTAxQy9ZbHZSMVg0VUFWdz09

  WRITTEN COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE SUBMITTED TO
  Cultural.Heritage@longbeach.gov

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  23-40251  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  23-40179  Recommendation to approve the minutes of the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting on Tuesday, September 26, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  23-40358  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the City of Long Beach’s
  Ethics Program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  23-40459  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to allow the demolition of a
  312 square-foot deck to construct a 575 square-foot addition to the rear of a one-
  story single-family dwelling. 660 Mira Mar Avenue within the Belmont Heights
  Historic District and in the Single-Family Residential District with Standard Lots (R-
  1-N) Zoning District. It is a Contributor to the Belmont Heights Historic District.
  (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  23-40460  Recommendation to review the landmark nomination, background materials, make
  all appropriate findings and recommend that the City Council designate the exterior
  of the former Fire Station No. 9 building located at 3917 Long Beach Boulevard in
  the Commercial Community Automobile-Oriented (CCA) Zoning District as a
  Locally Designated Historic Landmark building. (District 5)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Cultural Heritage Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Office
of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

5.  23-40460  Recommendation to review the landmark nomination, background materials, make
  all appropriate findings and recommend that the City Council designate the exterior
  of the former Fire Station No. 9 building located at 3917 Long Beach Boulevard in
  the Commercial Community Automobile-Oriented (CCA) Zoning District as a
  Locally Designated Historic Landmark building. (District 5)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Grisafe, seconded by Commissioner
  Bodek, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the motion.

  A motion was made by Chair Irvine, seconded by Commissioner Bodek, to
  make all appropriate findings and recommend that the City Council [1]
  designate the exterior of the former Fire Station No. 9 building located at 3917
  Long Beach Boulevard as a locally designated historic Landmark building, [2]
  designate for interior landmarking and preservation of the fireplace and built-
  ins located in the reception room, the wood truss ceiling, and the interior
  hose radio, [3] request the adaptive reuse of the other features identified in
  the landmark application and if they cannot be reused, photograph and
  catalog the features subject to the Historic American Building Survey
  guidelines provided by the National Park Service (NPS), and [4] include in the
  landmarking ordinance a requirement that a plaque providing the historic
  context of the landmark be installed on the exterior of the building. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  5  Irvine, McGuan, Bodek, Grisafe, Pizzo
